requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: the cross-track beamforming weights are computed per scan line to suppress stray-light contamination from adjacent swaths
formulating the problem as a constrained beamformer (minimum-variance with sidelobe bounds)

requirements.note: The beamformer described is for an optical detector array (pushbroom imager), not an RF/radar/sonar array as the requirement's examples suggest; the algorithmic and delivery detail given (named project, technique, MATLAB prototype, production shipment) is concrete, so evidence_found is used, with the domain match left to the recruiter's judgement per the refuse-to-guess rule.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience

lines.quote: I also have experience with satellite and airborne platform requirements from a systems-integration perspective, though the core of my career has been in the optical signal domain rather than RF.

requirements.note: Asserted with no named project, mission, or platform detail backing it.

lines.quote: Finnish and EU citizen, no work-permit restrictions for any EU deployment.
Documentation and internal training materials written in English, which is the company's working language for all engineering documentation and cross-site communication with the Trondheim office.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any production embedded signal-processing software you have written in C or C++ that ran on real hardware under timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any Python code you have written to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe your hands-on RF test-bench experience, such as network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
